about.title: About Khamar
about.subtitle: We build tools for the people who feed us.
about.body: Khamar started with a simple idea: farm software should feel as natural as the work itself. We work with farmers, managers and vets across Bangladesh to build an ERP that is fast, affordable and honest about the numbers. No jargon. No clutter. Just clarity.
